description: Eurostar GTFS Feed is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Eurostar. Provides a GTFS formatted data feed of trains in the Eurostar network, that contains the planification for the next 90 days, as well as realtime updates regarding cancellations and delays. Release notes can be found here:. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 3 resources in GTFS. The data standards named are gtfs. The national access point types are RTTI. The portal shows 2026-07-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
